# Chakudya Nutrition Registry

> Open nutrition data and intelligence infrastructure for Malawi: food composition, growth references, clinical nutrition data and an API for health professionals, researchers, students and developers.

Chakudya means "food" in Chichewa. The registry is served through a public REST API described by an OpenAPI specification.

## Documentation

- [Home](https://chakudya.xyz/): Overview of the registry, live record counts and a food lookup demo
- [Getting started](https://chakudya.xyz/docs/getting-started/): First API request and authentication
- [API reference](https://chakudya.xyz/docs/api-reference/): Every endpoint, parameters and example responses
- [NutriMind](https://chakudya.xyz/nutrimind/): Nutrition assistant that answers with sources from the registry

## Machine-readable

- [OpenAPI specification (JSON)](https://chakudya.xyz/openapi.json): Full API description
- [OpenAPI specification (YAML)](https://chakudya.xyz/openapi.yaml): Same specification in YAML
- [Sitemap](https://chakudya.xyz/sitemap.xml): Indexable pages

## Optional

- [Source code](https://github.com/edisontaimu9-ui/chakudya-api): API repository on GitHub
- [Submit a packaged food](https://chakudya.xyz/submit/): Contribute a missing product
